reviews.t: Waited for a chance to buy this. Worth it.
reviews.x: A chiro student here. Have not used Activators of any types (Type 2 or Type 4) before, so this is my first tool. Once I got it, I used it on someone I know and it worked well! This works similarly to an activator type 2 where the tool just has to be placed at the spot that you desire.  Pros: -The box is small, covered in foam when it arrived. Simple manual and instructions are included inside. -This is a great tool if you decide to save some money instead of buying the 'branded' version. (Type 2

Bought this to use on my Golden Retriever and myself. Seems like a silly little nothing machine but WOW.. what a difference it has made in our lives. I had my chiropractor teach me how to use it. Love it!

reviews.t: Will not replace the actual activator
reviews.x: I use the activator on some of my patients in practice, and was looking to get an additional one as back up.  I thought I would give this a try since it was a fraction of the price of the actual activator.  However, in this case you get what you pay for.  When I first held it in my hand and tried using it, it felt very light and flimsy.  I have been using the same activator for over 12 years, and it is still working great.  This feels as though it will fall apart in a year, if I'm lucky.  Also o

reviews.t: Wish you could buy a manual to learn all the ...
reviews.x: Wish you could buy a manual to learn all the ways of using this - I'm not a chiropractor - but why sell it to others if no manual available??

saved me many trips to the chiropractor.  i've seen chiropractors for the past 35 years, i know when my neck is out of whack.  this thing is amazing and wonderful.  had it used on me so many times in their offices i knew just what i needed to do with it.  love it.

reviews.t: This was a fantastic purchase. My dog suffers from disc disease
reviews.x: This was a fantastic purchase. My dog suffers from disc disease. His back will bother him from time to time. I used this on him during one of his episodes and it helps immediately. My vet was charging $40 a visit for the same therapy. I am able to do this at home without the stress of a vet visit. I've used it on my own neck and it delivers quite a punch.

Effective enough tool.  I am a chiropractor and activator is not my typical treatment style - as a result I'm not looking to spend too much on the tool.  This is my second budget level manipulating tool and, while effective, I prefer my first only because the length of the trigger recoil is shorter on the first one.  This allows quicker recoil and subsequently quicker reactivation of the tool.  It might become a matter of familiarity, but I find this unit slower to use.  Solid unit for the price

Not quite as pretty as an activator but just as effective and for the price... GET IT.  Easy to use, adjustable force I recommend getting the rubber pads for the palm and finger as well as a cervical tip to improve comfort for yourself and patient.

I bought this to treat my mule, but found me using it more and more on myself lol.  I can't make it to the chiropractor, to the masseuse etc on a regular basis with my life and work schedule.  So a couple of these to the area works great.  To those that say this is a medical device and could cause permanent damage, you cannot damage yourself with this unless you ingest it.  This does not deliver a punch that would hurt someone.  It merely acts on the small area you are needing relief of.  Even t
Great product! It works the same way as Activator does only this one is cheaper. Quality of the material is great. Handle is very comfortable. Highly recommend!

I no longer have access to an Activator Chiropractor and even if I did I’m tired of breaking in new doctors. I purchased this and I’ve been pain and chiropractor free for 6 months now. It’s paid for itself 6 times over. There is a learning curve: placing it hard against your body won’t work. I’ve discovered the best way to get the most power is to just barely touch the skin in the area you want to adjust; almost hovering over the spot. Absolutely worth it!

This is just what I was looking for and at a reasonable price.  I have several patients with arthritic joints and decreased disc spaces that make it impossible to get satisfying relief from diversified adjusting.  Treatment with this tool along with deep tissue stretching and axial decompression increases mobility, decreases pain and discomfort as well as restores function.  I would buy this product again in the future, if I needed to and from this seller, as service and shipping time was excell

The price is as cheap as you can find for a chiropractic type tool that's for an adjustment. I still prefer the actual Activator, but this works really just as well, and it is well made. There is no reference on how much force your giving with each turn of the adjusting sleeve, so you just have to test it before using it on a patient.
I have used this item for several months and it does the job of reducing trigger point pain.  Seems solid and is holding up well with much use.  Glad I bought it.

Product came in a regular box with padding, which is where i will continue to store it. I looked at many different sellers on amazon for the same product before buying.  It had good weight on it, did not feel flimsy or weak like other reviews for similar products. Contrary to another review on a similar product, there was a significant difference in the force produced from the first and lowest setting to the last and strongest. When comparing it to the actual brand Activator 2 and 4, its a good
Does not put enough pressure.  I'm office manager for a chiropractor and he greatly disliked these.  Seller did not respond to my email when I tried to ask questions.

It's a life saver when it comes to loosening those tight muscles. If you get a lot of neck, shoulder or back muscle knots...this is a great little tool...even if you see a chiropractor regularly...as my family does. It never fails...the weekend hits, the chiropractor is closed, and I have a stiff neck! This little clicker will loosen it right up and make you feel like a million bucks soon after and even better the next day. A great buy!

reviews.t: Love this thing! Use with caution, but Enjoy!
reviews.x: I Love this item!! I do use it cautiously, using what I have learned by going to years of chiro. I have studied A and P and am a Massage Therapist of old, but I just use this on myself and my husband. I LOVE it. I have saved myself from quite a few trips to the chiro already, so it is going to pay for itself quickly. I am SOOO glad to have finally bought one.! Highly recommended, especially if you have the same issues happen regularly and know how to treat it. You can teach your body more quickl

This tool had absolutely no kick! When I tried it out on my hand in the lowest setting I couldn't even feel a thing . Then I tried it out on the highest setting and it still didn't give a kick, more of a teeny tiny bump!  I would give it 1/2 star if I could! UPDATE! Originally I was only reviewing the tool itself...but I also have something to say about the vendor. It took over " 2 " months to WRANGLE my refund out of them. Need I say more...?

reviews.t: Almost worthless as an adjustment device.
reviews.x: I am a licensed practitioner and had never used this model for instrument adjusting. First, let me say if you are in pain, you would benefit more from having a trained person do a full assessment of the cause of your pain. As far as the instrument itself: the force and speed of the instrument are inadequate to obtain much benefit at all imo. I tried to return this but fell outside of the window of time so, $140 paperweight.

For occasional use, this works as well as the Activator brand for half the cost. It is simple, like the Activator I. Just be careful with the flexible plastic covers on the top (where your thumb is) and the middle (where fingers hold it) because they can slide off and get lost.

Seems to work very well. Good purchase. Now I wish someone would write a good 'How To Use' book in laymen's terms for at-home use. It's amazing how a little shock to a tight muscle tells it to relax - too bad it couldn't help my mind relax. For that I use whiskey.......:)

reviews.t: Quit in the middle of session
reviews.x: I was extremely happy with this tool until it just quit working in the middle of a session.  I tapped it on a table and it worked a few more times, then just quit.  For some reason it is working again this morning.  Maybe it was tired ?

my chiropractor began to use this on my neck because i could no longer take the sudden jerks (sorry, few technical terms here) she used to deliver to it. she taught me how to use it, and how not to abuse it (don't use it every day!). i can honestly say that it has helped. a couple of vertebra in my neck are out of straight alignment, and can, at times, pop out more. if i use this when the condition worsens, a couple of shots, every other day; and, if i am mindful of my posture and do my gentle s

reviews.t: My Chiropractor Suggested getting this adjusting tool
reviews.x: My Chiropractor was using this tool along the side of my spine for an adjustment for sciatica pain and on the muscles down my leg to loosen those muscles that get a death grip on the sciatic nerve. I knew it would be pricey but I can say it has been worth it! I use it the same way my Chiropractor uses it. It does relieve the pain in my lower back and loosens the muscles. claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the tool works well and is effective, often comparing it favorably to the actual Activator.
Many praise it as a great value for the price compared to the real Activator.
Several reviewers use it at home to save money and avoid trips to the chiropractor or vet.
Some note a learning curve or lack of instructions/manual on how to use it.
A few say it does not fully replace the actual Activator, citing differences like recoil length or force reference.
